bindings.caption: Add octylamine at the source-defined stage. After octylamine is added to already formed MSCs, the remaining MSCs switch from heterogeneous to homogeneous growth. The source reports a broader final size distribution than for octylamine in the initial injection. Exact precursor quantities and a numerical final absorption maximum are not separately reported for this late-addition experiment.
